text:
alex: Morning — quick async standup. What I did / blockers / today:

priya & team: FYI I'm kicking off a small canary for route-weight changes on /v1/build (PR #892). Did: adjusted ratepolicy default from 200/s -> 180/s for thin clients to reduce unit cost. Blocker: seeing intermittent 429s in eu-staging when burst >5k reqs/min, looks like token-bucket exhaustion. Today: add throttling header to surface bucket metrics and pair with priya on authz checks. :coffee:

priya: saw the 429s too earlier, traced to a jwt rotation edge with the ingress proxy. I added extra logging in the auth middleware (PR #895) and a short retry on 401->re-auth. No blockers on my side. Today: will spin the canary to eu1 for 2 hours and watch KV hit ratio.

chris: did a minor tweak to the route matcher to support anchor match on /v1/search (helps a customer use-case). Did: triggered an incremental config flush on nx-proxies. Blocker: integration tests flaky — routing table reload sometimes times out. Today: revert the full table flush and switch to a streaming reload to avoid lock contention.

mika: ran the Optimize perf sweep across grpc pools. Did: reduced batch_window from 15ms -> 10ms, improved p50 by ~6%. Blocker: observed a long-tail latency regression when KV cache misses happen concurrently with batching. Today: will instrument KV cache hit ratio and add a small cache warmup on rollout.

jenna: added a new "rollback-on-429" canary policy under rollout configs in the console. Did: updated feature-flag UI to expose the toggle. Blocker: UI shows stale policy state until manual refresh. Today: implement websocket patch to push policy updates to the client.

deploy-bot: Canary PR #892 -> weight 20% -> eu-staging. Health checks passed at 2024-11-13T10:03Z. Logs: 0/50 errors in 5m.

alex: quick ask — can someone review PR #892 when free? It's a small change but need second pair before bumping weight to 50%. Link: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/892

priya: on it, starting review now.

chris: quick note from logs: gatekeeper returned 401 for a subset of requests — token validation failed after rotation. Suspect KMS key suffix mismatch in the new agent image. If reproducible I'll open ticket.

mika: captured a sample of the offending rate policy config that correlates with bursts. Snippet below:

```yaml
rate_policy:
  type: token_bucket
  capacity: 500
  refill_rate_per_second: 3
  burst_tolerance: 2
```

mika: increasing refill_rate_per_second to 5 in staging eliminated the immediate 429s in my local replay.

alex: good catch. Let's try bumping refill_rate_per_second to 5 in eu-staging and observe for 30m. If stable, incrementally adjust in canary.

priya: applying change now via `kubectl apply -f infra/ratepolicy-eu.yaml --context=eu-staging` — will watch metrics and post back.

jenna: ping me if you want me to pause the canary while you test — I can flip the rollout policy quickly. :thumbsup:

chris: opened ticket #4567 to track the KMS rotation mismatch and linked the console logs.

alex: great. No other blockers from me — pairing with priya at 11:00 to validate token refresh flows.

priya: update: refill_rate bumped to 5, staging 30m looks clean so far (p95 down, 429s dropped). I'll post a short chart in ~30m.

alex: awesome — thanks all. If reviews come back green we'll bump canary weight after noon. :rocket:
